english.title: Driver of a vehicle carrying dangerous / pressurised goods fail to keep orange placards in good order

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations 2009

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), carrying goods or equipment subject to the Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations 2009, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CHARACTER OF THE GOODS / EQUIPMENT..),

(A)_[in a container,]_
(B)_[in a multiple-element gas container,]_
(C)_[in an uncertified multiple-element gas container,]_
(D)_[in a tank-container,]_
(E)_[in a portable tank,]_
(F)_[in a demountable tank,]_
(G)_[which were packaged,]_
(H)_[in bulk,]_

failed to ensure that such orange placards displayed on the vehicle as prescribed and in the manner required by regulation 5 were maintained in good order in that **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE IN RELATION TO CLEANLINESS, CORRECT POSITION, VERTICAL, UNOBSCURED ETC..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 5 of the Carriage of Dangerous Goods and Use of Transportable Pressure Equipment Regulations 2009 and section 33(1)(c) and (3) of the Health and Safety at Work etc Act 1974.

english.notes:
(i) For further guidance see the prosecution guide.
(ii) Where there is evidence that the consignor has received previous verbal/written advice then prosecution may be considered subject to current HSE policy. If it can be shown that there is a risk of serious injury then a prohibition notice would be appropriate.
(iii) ADR 2009 section 5.3 refers

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
